name: floating-navbar
blurb: Floating navbar that hides/shows on scroll direction.
description: Navbar that animates in/out based on scroll direction. Shows when scrolling up, hides when scrolling down. Nav items can include icons.
use_when: Single-page apps or long-scroll interfaces where hiding navbar on scroll reclaims space.
avoid_when: Short pages where scroll behavior feels glitchy.
a11y: Nav items are keyboard-navigable links. Icons optional (can have sr-only text). Scroll-driven animations don't affect keyboard navigation.

props.name: navItems
props.type: { name: string; link: string; icon?: JSX.Element }[]
